name: WWE Chaos Championship
epitaph: The fed's own served Title History page runs an undated, numbered twelve-reign ledger, now structured in full: Jay Taylor (four reigns), Rick Esteban, Bassel Noori ("B", twice), DJ Finch (twice), and Eli Jimenez (twice) all hold it in turn, with Tony Lozon's own single reign the only other name on the list.

name: WWE Chaos Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The fed's own served Title History page runs an undated, numbered ten-reign ledger for its own tag titles. "Night and Day" (Bassel Noori and Jay Taylor) and "DS Inc." (Josh Render and Greg Martus) each hold the belts three times over; "The Rednecks" name is held by two different pairings in turn (DJ Finch with Tony Lozon, then DJ Finch with Brandon Walsh); Nick Clyne and Ben Galster ("703"), DJ Finch and Ryan Bronkama, and Jay Taylor and Tony Lozon each hold it once. No exact dates survive on the ledger page itself; the fed's own served 5 January 2005 broadcast independently confirms the ledger's own last-recorded pairing, DJ Finch and Brandon Walsh, still champions at that date.
